# Adding `myapp-logs-{env}` S3 Bucket + IRSA Role + Flux Kustomization

Below are all the files to create/modify, following knr-ops idioms (ACK CRDs, kustomize base→overlay, Flux kustomization with `dependsOn`).

---

## Directory Structure

```
infra/
└── logs/
    ├── base/
    │   ├── kustomization.yaml
    │   ├── s3-bucket.yaml
    │   ├── s3-versioning.yaml
    │   ├── s3-sse.yaml
    │   ├── s3-public-access-block.yaml
    │   ├── iam-role.yaml
    │   └── iam-role-policy.yaml
    ├── dev/
    │   ├── kustomization.yaml
    │   ├── patch-s3-bucket.yaml
    │   ├── patch-iam-role.yaml
    │   └── patch-iam-role-policy.yaml
    └── prod/
        ├── kustomization.yaml
        ├── patch-s3-bucket.yaml
        ├── patch-iam-role.yaml
        └── patch-iam-role-policy.yaml
flux/
└── kustomizations.yaml          (updated)
```

---

## 1. Base Kustomization

**`infra/logs/base/kustomization.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

labels:
  - pairs:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp-logs
      app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: knr-ops
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: myapp
    includeSelectors: true

resources:
  - s3-bucket.yaml
  - s3-versioning.yaml
  - s3-sse.yaml
  - s3-public-access-block.yaml
  - iam-role.yaml
  - iam-role-policy.yaml

commonAnnotations:
  meta.k8s.aws/mutating-policies: s3BucketPolicy
```

---

## 2. S3 Bucket (Base)

**`infra/logs/base/s3-bucket.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  for:
    bucketName: myapp-logs
    acl: private
    forceDestroy: false
  managementPolicies:
    - providerSource: Default
      effects:
        - Create
        - Update
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  terminationPolicy: Delete
```

---

## 3. S3 Versioning

**`infra/logs/base/s3-versioning.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketVersioningConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-versioning
spec:
  for:
    bucketName: myapp-logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      status: Enabled
  managementPolicies:
    - providerSource: Default
      effects:
        - Create
        - Update
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

---

## 4. S3 Server-Side Encryption (AES-256)

**`infra/logs/base/s3-sse.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-sse
spec:
  for:
    bucketName: myapp-logs
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
        bucketKeyEnabled: false
  managementPolicies:
    - providerSource: Default
      effects:
        - Create
        - Update
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

---

## 5. S3 Public Access Block

**`infra/logs/base/s3-public-access-block.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketPublicAccessBlockConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-public-access-block
spec:
  for:
    bucketName: myapp-logs
    publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
      blockPublicAcls: true
      blockPublicPolicy: true
      ignorePublicAcls: true
      restrictPublicBuckets: true
  managementPolicies:
    - providerSource: Default
      effects:
        - Create
        - Update
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
```

---

## 6. IAM Role for IRSA (Base)

**`infra/logs/base/iam-role.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMRole
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  for:
    name: myapp-logs-irsa
    description: "IRSA role for myapp-logs S3 bucket access"
    # Placeholder trust policy — replaced by overlay patch
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": { "Federated": "__OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN__" },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "__OIDC_ISSUER__:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
                "__OIDC_ISSUER__:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    tags:
      "knr-ops/managed-by": "flux"
  managementPolicies:
    - providerSource: Default
      effects:
        - Create
        - Update
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  terminationPolicy: Delete
```

---

## 7. IAM Role Policy (Base)

**`infra/logs/base/iam-role-policy.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMRolePolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy
spec:
  for:
    name: myapp-logs-irsa-policy
    roleName: myapp-logs-irsa
    # Placeholder resource ARN — replaced by overlay patch
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:GetObjectVersion",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:DeleteObject",
              "s3:DeleteObjectVersion",
              "s3:ListBucket",
              "s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads",
              "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts",
              "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
              "s3:RestoreObject"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::__BUCKET_NAME__",
              "arn:aws:s3:::__BUCKET_NAME__/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
  managementPolicies:
    - providerSource: Default
      effects:
        - Create
        - Update
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  terminationPolicy: Delete
```

---

## 8. Dev Overlay

**`infra/logs/dev/kustomization.yaml`**

```yaml

kind: Kustomization

namespace: knr-ops

  - path: patch-iam-role.yaml

```

**`infra/logs/dev/patch-s3-bucket.yaml`**

```yaml
  namespace: knr-ops

---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1

metadata:

  namespace: knr-ops
spec:
  for:

---
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1

spec:
  for:

```

**`infra/logs/dev/patch-iam-role.yaml`**

```yaml
        "Version": "2012-10-17",

          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs",
                "oidc.eks.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
```
